verdict.rationale: Versioning, review, and rollback are fair capabilities to expect from a messaging-automation platform, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions automation version history, change review, or rollback. The docs show that AI agents can create and manage automations via the MCP server and CLI, and that read, write, and delete tool permissions can be approved separately. That is permission gating on agent actions, not versioning or rollback of automations.
